_meta.purpose: Maps ATP main-tour event -> tier + per-edition singles draw size + surface. Supplies the TIER that api-tennis does not expose (it lumps everything as 'Atp Singles').
_meta.tier_source: Official ATP results archive atptour.com/en/scores/results-archive?year=YYYY (100% of tier values; authoritative).
_meta.draw_source: Per-event official-year draw (ATP category pages / ATP 2026 calendar PDF / per-edition infoboxes). Cells not confirmable from an official source are null (no guess).
_meta.regime: 2025 + 2026 seasons; covers a rolling-52wk window ending 2026-09-08.
_meta.match_key: Match on host city first (feed keys on city), fall back to normalized name. 'London' is shared (Wimbledon GS + Queen's 500) and 'Paris' is shared (Roland Garros GS + Paris Masters) -> disambiguate by name/surface, never city alone.
_meta.null_rule: draw=null means the official draw for that edition was not published/confirmable at build time; compute -> dash, never a default. All current nulls are future-2026 events outside the window ending 2026-09-08.
archive_errors_corrected: Houston (US Men's Clay Court Champ): 2025 archive mislabels surface 'Hard' -> corrected to Clay.
Athens (Hellenic Championship 2025): archive mislabels 'Clay' -> corrected to Hard (indoor), OAKA Arena.
provisional_notes: Paris Masters 2026 draw (venue sources say 48) NOT on atptour.com -> null.
Lyon 2026 (new event) draw not posted -> null.
Next Gen Finals 2026 existence provisional; awards 0 ranking points regardless.
